Homeland Security Secretary Mullin said there is no cyberattack or danger to the public, and that it is not «a new 11 September», but according to Ansa he also said that nothing can be ruled out regarding the causes. CNN, cited by Ansa, speaks of over 3,000 cancelled flights and about 700 aircraft still in flight during the night. According to Cirium, reports Al Jazeera, at least 827 flights were diverted. Eurocontrol suspended European flights bound for the United States for a period at the request of the FAA, writes Ansa.

Duffy expects a return to full operations by Thanksgiving, in less than two weeks, and has requested $50 billion to modernise the system, reports Al Jazeera.
